title: Remove reader-side export backfills from website load-games
description:
`website/src/utils/load-games.ts` is doing runtime backfills for old export shapes instead of reading a stable schema. Today it:
- Recomputes `toolCallsOk` and `toolCallsFailed` from `llmEvents` when player fields are missing.
- Recomputes `thinkingTimeSecs` from adjacent `llmEvents` when player fields are missing.
- Uses silent defaults for fields like `deckType`, `harnessEpoch`, and `season`.

That is effectively backwards-compatibility logic in the website reader. It conflicts with the repo rule against fallbacks/shims and makes the website responsible for understanding multiple historical export layouts.

This repo already has export schema versions and migration tooling. Use that machinery instead:
1. Migrate old exports forward so the website reads one shape.
2. Remove the reader-side backfill logic from `load-games.ts`.
3. Make the loader fail fast when required fields are missing.
4. Add or update tests for the migrated schema rather than patching missing fields at render time.
